data.one_liner: A test runner for Flutter and Dart that exposes a stream of TestEvent instances.
data.what_it_does: It runs Flutter or Dart test processes and exposes a stream of TestEvent instances based on the JSON reporter test protocol. It can execute both dart test and flutter test commands with custom arguments and working directories.
use_when: You are writing custom tooling that executes Flutter or Dart tests.
You need to parse or react to a stream of TestEvent instances from test runs.
avoid_when: You just want to run standard tests in a regular Flutter project without custom tooling.
strengths: Provides an easy-to-use stream interface for dart test and flutter test execution.
Built specifically for custom test tooling development.
weaknesses: Very niche use case, mostly intended for custom tooling authors.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: The core Dart testing package if you only need standard unit and widget testing capabilities.
